blocks.title: 全流程软件工程流水线

items.title: Allstar 主控
items.description: 只调度不干活：编排 13 环节流水，守护确认门，维护 state.md，驱动打回循环。

items.title: 辅助者
items.description: 常驻执行代理：越权命令统一收口，执行前先做 agent 级安全预审。

items.title: 11 个阶段手册
items.description: 需求+原型 → 架构 → 任务 → 开发/评审 → 白盒 → 黑盒（可选自测+核验）→ 部署 → 收尾，每环节产物硬校验。

items.title: Allstar Conductor
items.description: Schedules only: drives the 13-stage pipeline, guards confirmation gates, maintains state.md, routes rework loops.

items.title: Helper
items.description: Resident execution proxy: single entry point for escalated commands with an agent-level safety pre-review.

items.title: 11 stage manuals
items.description: Requirements+prototype → architecture → tasks → dev/review → whitebox → blackbox (optional self-test + user review) → deploy → finalize, each gated by artifact checks.
